results.text: Outpatient Treatment of Postbariatric Hypoglycemia With Canagliflozin. The goal of this study was to examine canagliflozin's efficacy in treating postbariatric hypoglycemia (PBH) in a real-world setting. We hypothesized that canagliflozin, a sodium-glucose cotransporter 1/2 inhibitor, would reduce postprandial hyperglycemia and hypoglycemia.
